products.title: Counterculture: Counters & Submissions by Geo Martinez
products.body:
Enter the Counterculture with 10th Planet’s Geo Martinez and Escape, Defend, and Counter with Some of The Most Unorthodox and Effective Techniques in The game
  • Geo “Freakazoid” Martinez is a 3rd Degree Black Belt under Eddie Bravo and one of 10th Planet’s most decorated and recognized figures, with an ADCC Trials Title and multiple EBI Titles to his credit
  • Learn these unique “freak style” escapes and counters to completely revolutionize your defense and put you back on the attack
  • Escape high percentage submissions like the armbar, kimura, guillotine, and more with 10th Planet style details that you won’t see anywhere else
  • Attack with your own devastating subs as you exit from dangerous positions using seamless transitions and signature movement from Geo’s own personal toolbox
  • Dismantle and escape a fully locked triangle, survive the spiderweb position, exit the honeyhole unscathed, unlock the north south pin, and  much much more in this comprehensive guide to removing yourself from horrible spots and getting back on the attack
  • Develop strong defense that will give you an increased sense of confidence in your entire game and the tools to survive some of BJJ’s most dangerous attacks

products.title: Mount Dominance by Brandon McCaghren
products.body:
Develop a More Dominant Mount and Learn The “Musts” of The No Gi Top Game Featuring 10th Planet Black Belt Instructor, Brandon McCaghren
  • Brandon McCaghren is a black belt under Eddie Bravo and one of 10th Planet’s most acclaimed instructors, staking his claim as the first 10P instructor in the Southeastern United States
  • Take an unorthodox approach to some classic jiu-jitsu themes, and revolutionize the way you attack from one of BJJ’s most underutilized positions, all with a 10th Planet Black Belt at the helm
  • The mount is an entirely different animal in no gi and we must adapt our games to reflect these major differences so we can still dominate from this important position
  • Learn superior body positioning tactics that you’ve never seen before so you can transform your no gi mount game from average to extraordinary
  • Explore a densely packed instructional that includes positional guidance, tons of submissions, finishing mechanics, mount maintenance strategies, and more all with the added 10th Planet flare that you’ll only get from a seasoned 10P black belt
  • Discover the spiderweb, the mounted rubber guard sugar hold, the punch choke, mounted triangle gold, multiple back takes, the chopping block, and more, all with exquisite details and guidance you won’t find anywhere else

products.title: Guard Master: How To guard Them All by Geo Martinez
products.body:
Attack Relentlessly From Your Back With 10th-Planet Black Belt & Elite Competitor Geo Martinez’s Creative & Effective System For No-Gi Guard Play
  • Use the no-gi guard to take the back, sweep on top, and get to submission locks, all supercharged with Geo’s 10th Planet creativity
  • Fight with a De La X guard, Geo’s Butter Half, reverse De La Riva, and more for multiple opportunities to attack
  • Get an inside look at the 10th-Planet guard that Geo has learned and innovated on to create this unique system
  • You don’t need crazy flexibility or speed to do any of these moves, Geo shows you how he teaches his students to use these techniques at any level
  • Geo Martinez is one of the most prominent and successful 10th Planet Jiu-Jitsu black belts, with his own school and incredible success against elite compeition

Learn Classic 10th Planet Positions And Attacks Like The Lock Down, De La X, Homie Control, And More!

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

The no-gi guard continues to evolve and Geo Martinez has been on the forefront of that movement with his creative and effective work from his back. Now is your chance to learn from this elite competitor and 10th Planet Jiu-Jitsu black belt instructor as Geo shows you all the techniques and strategies you can use for guard success on this 4-volume series.

Fight from your back with details on some of Geo’s best guards, including De La X, reverse De La Riva, spiral guard, and more. Combine these highly effective positions with Geo’s advice on getting the most leverage possible, including some of his favorite combinations for competition.

Geo shows you the butter half guard that he has developed over the year for incredible offensive output. With only a few modifications to classic half, you can begin attacking with kimuras, guillotines, lockdowns, and more. This half guard system is a great position for grapplers of all ages to slow down the fight and attack on their own terms.

Geo Martinez is one of 10th Planet’s premier black belts, with an incredible competition career that includes multiple ADCC appearances and EBI Championships. His system that he teaches is safe, effective, and useful for grapplers of all ages - no crazy athleticism or flexibility necessary.


So, What Exactly Do You Get?

products.title: The Ultimate Path to the Rubber Guard by Jeremiah Vance
products.body:
10th Planet Standout Jeremiah Vance Shares The Secrets Behind The Rubber Guard System That He Uses To Win With Style
  • Jeremiah Vance is a 10th Planet black belt who has been one of their most successful and exciting grapplers for years, and now he gives you insights into some of his best attacks
  • Work from the 10th Planet rubber guard, with Jeremiah’s coaching through this control-based closed guard system
  • Start to isolate the arms and neck as Jeremiah’s system shows you how to set up armbars, triangles, omoplatas, and even gogoplatas
  • Jeremiah shows you how to improve at the rubber guard with solo drills to gain dexterity and flexibility, and partner drills that you can use to begin gaining experience in the system
  • Sweep your way into dominant positions using some of Jeremiah’s strongest techniques, including the Jersey Sweep, Gogo Launch, and more
